title: 用量批次冪等、亂序缺口、衝突稽核與簽章檢查點恢復 (Idempotent Usage Ingest, Contiguous ACK, Conflict Audit & Signed Checkpoint Recovery)
expected: POST /api/v1/agent/usage-batches enforces idempotent batch replay, per-event duplicate/conflict/rejected status, contiguous ACK watermark (highest_contiguous_seq & blocked_seq), >2^53 decimal string precision, and Ed25519-signed GET /api/v1/agent/usage-checkpoint recovery.
actual: Live mTLS /api/v1/agent/usage-checkpoint and /api/v1/agent/usage-batches on enrolled node 01a18a49-4020-71c6-ad22-893acd249a8b (incarnation 01a18a49-4253-781f-9f9e-de9c6c24c5ec) verified Ed25519 recovery signature, out-of-order seq {22,24} -> gap fill seq 23 advancing highest_contiguous_seq to 24, batch replay, duplicate event, payload_sha256 conflict audit (usage_event_conflicts=5), rejected seq 26 blocked_seq=26 advancing to 27, and 409/403 error envelopes. Non-empty member UsageRecord ingestion on the unseeded live stack is blocked because device_bindings has 0 rows.
blockers: Live non-empty member UsageRecord ingestion on the unseeded stack is blocked because validateEventBindingsInTx requires an active device_bindings row and entitlement interval, while device_bindings count=0 and plan creation returns HTTP 422.

commands.command: docker exec fvpn-w4-usage-node nft list chain inet fvpn forward
mTLS POST /api/v1/agent/usage-batches (fill gap seq 23 -> contiguous ACK 24)
mTLS POST /api/v1/agent/usage-batches (seq 25, rejected seq 26, seq 27 -> blocked_seq=26; valid seq 26 -> highest_contiguous_seq=27)

mechanism_checks.name: LiveMTLSUsageCheckpointEd25519Verification
mechanism_checks.summary: Live mTLS GET /api/v1/agent/usage-checkpoint for node 01a18a49-4020-71c6-ad22-893acd249a8b verified against /etc/vpn-node/trust.json (purpose=recovery): ledger_epoch=c3cd0d36-1b5b-4000-bef6-ef8ed4c49653, recovery_record_id=null, highest_contiguous_seq=21.

mechanism_checks.name: LiveMTLSUsageBatchesContiguousAckConflictBlockedSeqAndErrorEnvelopes
mechanism_checks.summary: Live mTLS /api/v1/agent/usage-batches proved out-of-order seq {22,24} holding highest_contiguous_seq=22 with missing_ranges=[{23,23}], Idempotency-Key batch replay, duplicate retry, seq 23 gap fill advancing ACK to 24, payload_sha256 conflict audit (USAGE_EVENT_CONFLICT), rejected seq 26 reporting blocked_seq=26 then advancing to 27, and 409/403 whole-request guards.

mechanism_checks.name: ContiguousAckAndDecimalStringPrecisionAbove2Pow53
mechanism_checks.summary: Out-of-order sequences {1, 3} hold highest_contiguous_seq at 1 with missing_ranges=[{2,2}] until seq 2 arrives (advancing to 3); 2^53+1 (9007199254740993) and 2^53+3 (9007199254740995) round-trip as exact decimal strings.

mechanism_checks.name: DuplicateBatchLostAckAndConflictBlockedSeq
mechanism_checks.summary: Batch resends and lost-ACK retries never double-count bytes; conflicting payload_sha256 records usage_event_conflicts and rejected events set blocked_seq=6 while holding highest_contiguous_seq=5.

mechanism_checks.name: CentralDBRestoreSignedCheckpointAndReplayReconciliation
mechanism_checks.summary: FreezeIngest returns 503; BeginRecovery rotates ledger_epoch with a signed PurposeLedgerEpoch record; old epoch batches return 409 LEDGER_EPOCH_MISMATCH; Ed25519-verified PurposeRecovery checkpoint guides replay_unavailable tombstone reconciliation without inventing bytes.
